title: Fylgja probe package 1
description: How one probe format's hosts are run: written as YAML (probes/<format>.yaml), read by the compiler (the format exists), the drivers' plan (the host's image and set-up commands), the reconcile loop (readiness), flows and verify's burst.
$comment: Commands are argument vectors, never shell lines; placeholders: {interface} the host's data port, {address} its address with prefix, {far_address} the far host's address without prefix, {gateway}, {interval}, {count}, {wait}. Format 1 is IPv4 only: the declaration accepts IPv4 addresses alone, so no family field is needed. Runtime-specific parts live under runtime.containerlab, as a platform package's do.

probe_package_version.description: The format's version; the package loader refuses any other (rule package.version.unsupported).

format.description: The probe format this package runs; a blueprint probe's format names it, and the compiler refuses one no loaded package declares (rule probe.format.unknown).

interface.description: The host's one data port; the plan cables it to the device's port and renders {interface} with it.

address.description: The command that puts the host's address on its port; the plan renders it into the host's start-up commands.

route.description: The command that routes the far host through the gateway; the plan renders it into the host's start-up commands.

host.description: How a host is set up when its container starts; read by the drivers' plan.

command.description: Run inside the host by the reconcile loop's ready phase, through the driver's exec.

expect.description: Rendered, the text the ready phase waits to see in the command's output.

timeout_s.description: Bound on the host becoming ready; the ready phase fails with readiness.timeout after it.

readiness.description: When a host counts as ready; read by the reconcile loop.

interval_s.description: Seconds between packets; flows render {interval} with it and the step's loss report states it.

command.description: The long-running flow, started in each host after a step's stage and interrupted after its wait; flows read its counters as the step's loss.

start_timeout_s.description: Bound on starting a flow; flows record flow.start.failed after it.

read_timeout_s.description: Bound on stopping and reading a flow; flows record flow.read.failed after it.

flow.description: The continuous flow a step measures loss with; read by flows.

count.description: Packets per burst; verify renders {count} and holds the burst when every one is answered.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for each reply; verify renders {wait} with it.

command.description: The bounded burst verify runs in each host toward the far host (rule verify.burst when not held).

burst.description: Verify's burst assertion; read by verify.

approximations.description: How a probe's measurements differ from production traffic, asserted; the compile result's and each deployment's fidelity list them.

fidelity.description: What the package asserts of its own fidelity.

image.description: The host image and how it is acquired; read by the plan and by the local driver's presence check.

cpu.description: CPUs one host needs; a pod request on clabernetes, admission budget locally.

memory_mb.description: Memory one host holds; a pod request on clabernetes, admission budget locally.

resources.description: Per host; the plan sums them into the deployment's demand.

deploy_timeout_s.description: Bound on bringing a host up; the apply phase fails with apply.timeout after it.

destroy_timeout_s.description: Bound on removing a host; the destroy phase leaves the twin unclean after it.

containerlab.description: Read by both containerlab drivers; the host's kind is always linux.

runtime.description: Per-runtime sections, each read only by that runtime's drivers.

command.description: An argument vector with placeholders, run without a shell.
